protocolReview.distributedReservation: Documented sole-parent expected-head normal push, publication confirmation before work and fetch/revalidation after a race are consistent with the two-clone synthetic race test. Exclusive local file creation is explicitly not a distributed reservation.
protocolReview.cliPublishedPrecondition: CLI submission requires the exact active reservation in the explicitly fetched Git ref; review requires the exact published record; transfer requires published active reservation and all local unit records. Low-level Python functions are fixture/internal APIs and do not themselves prove remote publication.
protocolReview.ownershipTransfer: Immutable transfer chain, preserved record hashes, inherited snapshot subset guard, active-worker-only submission and late former-worker record rejection retain prior results/reviews. Synthetic A-to-B-to-C, fork and missing/foreign snapshot cases pass.
protocolReview.conflictPreservation: Existing claims/transfers/records/reviews are append-only; correction requires exact supersedes head; competing result or transfer branches fail rather than choosing timestamp. Git history checks reject edits/deletions including edit-then-restore.
protocolReview.evidenceAndScoring: Rubric and implementation agree on three 0..2 integer axes, explicit axis reasons, exact step-local quotes, clear support evidence, uncertain null scores, critical all-step evidence and separate actual-review attestations.
protocolReview.ciAndSummary: Workflow uses read-only repository permissions, synthetic tests, immutable-history validation, generated JSON/Markdown reports in runner temporary storage, step summary and uploaded artifacts. Generated reports do not feed inputDigest; checked-in REPORT is a coordinator snapshot and individual records remain authoritative.

resolvedFindings: Local writes previously could expose partial JSON: implementation now writes complete temporary bytes and links exclusively.
Each zero/uncertain score now requires an axis reason; critical requires an explicit reason; clear requires exact support evidence.
Generated report JSON excluded from authoritative input digest.
Chained ownership transfer now rejects dropping inherited grandfathered record hashes.
notVerified: No 800-question semantic audit, image/source reading, score calibration, real candidate assessment or learner-effect test.
No live GitHub Actions execution/artifact availability or remote PR/branch protection verification before PR creation; workflow behavior reviewed statically and its local commands exercised.
Recorded identities and coordinator labels are cooperative workflow attestations, not proof of separate humans or access-control enforcement.
Fresh remote fetch, sole-parent commit construction, non-force publication and stopped former workers remain documented operator preconditions.
Synthetic test file was authored by this reviewer; implementation was authored by the root agent. This record does not claim an independent second author review of the test design.
